_style: realistic documentary foley, natural, close-mic, no music, no voices unless asked

stamp.prompt: heavy rubber stamp pressed down hard on a thick paper file on a wooden desk, single dull thump

pop.prompt: soft muted paper card flicked onto a table, a short low tap

ding.prompt: drill pipe spinning freely in empty rock, hollow low clunk then silence

sparkle.prompt: small metal latch clicking into place with a short air hiss

collapse.prompt: massive underground rock collapse, deep rumbling cave-in with falling boulders and debris

cave.prompt: quiet deep underground mine ambience, low distant rumble, slow water drips, still air

clank.prompt: metal tin can set down on a metal shelf, small dull clank

whoosh.prompt: gentle air whoosh of someone turning quickly in a tunnel

bubble.prompt: a small sip of milk from a plastic cup, quiet slurp

snap.prompt: dry cracker snapped in half, crisp crunch

drill.prompt: large rotary drilling rig boring through rock far below, heavy diesel engine and grinding drill string

grind.prompt: drill bit grinding through the rock ceiling just overhead, loud rising scraping vibration and falling grit

burst.prompt: steel drill bit punching through a rock ceiling, sharp crack and a shower of gravel falling

rustle.prompt: paper note folded and tied with plastic tape, rustling paper

winch.prompt: steel cable winch reeling smoothly, electric motor hum and pulley wheel clicking

cheer.prompt: crowd of people outdoors cheering and clapping in celebration, joyful shouts

tube.prompt: long narrow metal canister sliding down a pipe and landing in hands, metallic scrape then soft catch

crack.prompt: hard rock fracturing, sharp stone crack

thud.prompt: steel capsule jolting and scraping against rock in a shaft, heavy metal thud

hatch.prompt: small metal hatch door unlatching and swinging open, latch clack and hinge squeak
